turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: What seems to be the problem?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: My left knee has been swollen and painful for two weeks, since I twisted it playing football.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Are you taking anything for it?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: I take ibuprofen 400 mg three times a day.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: The knee is swollen with a small effusion. I'd like an X-ray and a physiotherapy referral.
